INSERT INTO tb_minute_bar (market, symbol, bar_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, turnover) VALUES
(#{b.market}, #{b.symbol}, #{b.barTime}, #{b.openPrice}, #{b.highPrice}, #{b.lowPrice}, #{b.closePrice}, #{b.volume}, #{b.turnover})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_price = VALUES(open_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), volume = VALUES(volume), turnover = VALUES(turnover), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
